points.description: States the requirement: the connection must be two-way (full-duplex or half/semi-duplex), i.e. data flows in both directions between sender and receiver, so acknowledgements can ride on data frames going the other way. Also accept: data frames must contain an additional acknowledgement field. Either one earns the mark. Do not accept a one-way/simplex connection, or answers only about window size or timers.

rubric.notes: Full mark for stating that communication must be bidirectional (full-duplex or semi-duplex), or that frames need an extra acknowledgement field. No marks for simplex/one-way, or for unrelated requirements such as window size or timers. Do not give part marks.
